cases.name: read-scoop-plain
cases.note: No version: the broker cannot pin one through Scoop.

cases.name: read-scoop-version-unreadable
cases.note: Control: read-scoop-plain.

cases.name: read-scoop-version-unreadable-uninstall
cases.note: Package.Version through Scoop is unreadable on an Uninstall too. Control: read-scoop-uninstall-plain.

cases.name: read-scoop-channel-unreadable
cases.note: Control: read-scoop-plain.

cases.name: read-scoop-architecture-field
cases.note: Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies.

cases.note: Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies.

cases.note: Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies.

cases.note: Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies.

cases.note: Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies.

cases.name: read-scoop-manifest-url-untrusted-by-bucket
cases.note: A manifest URL is a known source, which a bucket selector does not match.

cases.name: read-scoop-manifest-url-named
cases.note: A Source selector can name a manifest URL; if the URL were an unknown source the selector would be unknown and not trust it.

cases.name: read-scoop-manifest-url-named-any-case
cases.note: Source names compare ignoring case (§text-comparison).

cases.name: read-scoop-manifest-url-any-source
cases.note: AnySource covers manifest URLs.

cases.name: read-scoop-skip-hash-check-upper
cases.note: An option name matches ignoring ASCII case. Control: read-scoop-skip-hash-check.

cases.name: read-scoop-short-upper-s
cases.note: '-S' is a short cluster containing 's', since names match ignoring ASCII case. Control: read-scoop-short-s.

cases.name: read-scoop-skip-hash-check-attached
cases.note: An option name ends at the element's first '=', so '--skip-hash-check=true' is '--skip-hash-check'. Control: read-scoop-skip-hash-check-longer-name.

cases.name: read-scoop-skip-hash-check-longer-name
cases.note: '--skip-hash-checks' is a longer name with '--skip-hash-check' as its prefix, not that option. Control: read-scoop-skip-hash-check-attached.

cases.name: read-scoop-cluster-hyphen-inside
cases.note: '-x-s' starts with one '-' followed by a character other than '-', so the whole element is one short cluster, and it contains 's'. Control: read-scoop-cluster-without-s.

cases.name: read-scoop-cluster-s-after-equals
cases.note: An option name ends at the element's first '=', so the cluster '-k=s' names only 'k'. Control: read-scoop-cluster-containing-s ('-ks').

cases.name: read-scoop-architecture-arch-attached
cases.note: '--arch=64bit' is '--arch', because an option name ends at the element's first '='. Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Control: read-scoop-architecture-longer-name.

cases.name: read-scoop-architecture-arch-upper-attached
cases.note: '--ARCH=64bit' is '--arch': the name ends at the first '=' and matches ignoring ASCII case. Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Control: read-scoop-architecture-longer-name.

cases.name: read-scoop-architecture-longer-name
cases.note: '--architecture=64bit' names '--architecture', a longer name with '--arch' as its prefix, which has no effect, so the architecture stays X64. Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies.

cases.name: read-scoop-architecture-short-upper-a
cases.note: '-A' is a short cluster containing 'a', since names match ignoring ASCII case. Package.Architecture is X64. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Control: read-scoop-architecture-field.

cases.name: read-scoop-uninstall-plain
cases.note: A readable Scoop Uninstall without a version; an Uninstall is never missing its version (§missing-version). Control for read-scoop-version-unreadable-uninstall, which adds Package.Version.
